title: Unlinked bonds and other unlinked debt: 15% of the whole gain

rate.notes: Capital gain on selling an unlinked bond, commercial paper, loan or "מילווה": no more than 15% (20% for a substantial shareholder), the whole nominal gain taxed (no inflation relief). The Minister may change the rate by order (s.91(b)(3)(b)); whether an order was ever made was not checked.
